sharedCommitNote: This commit also covers AUD-MVP-LIFECYCLE-001 (docs/program/evidence/closure/a/AUD-MVP-LIFECYCLE-001/TASK_EVIDENCE.json, same productSha). This record lists only the paths and tests directly proving the AI-handoff / exactly-one-receipt guarantee; the full 7-stage lifecycle proof and the segregation-of-duties/tenant/immutability corroboration live in the LIFECYCLE record.

changedPathRationale.server/migrations/20260910_claude_a_audi: The primary fix. registerAsInitiative (audits kernel, outside this lane's lease) is check-then-act with no transaction, no idempotency key and no unique constraint. Adds uq_initiatives_audit_source_once, a partial unique index on initiatives(organization_id, source_id) WHERE source_type='audit', so the losing concurrent createInitiative() call fails with 23505, which the kernel's existing try/catch already converts into a defined AUDIT_PROPOSAL_REGISTER_FAILED with zero application-code change needed. Adds uq_audit_initiative_proposals_registered_initiative_id as defence in depth. Both are additive/idempotent and preceded by a guarded pre-clean of real pre-existing duplicates (earliest kept, later ones detached, never deleted).
changedPathRationale.server/src/services/auditProgramHandoff/: New real-Postgres proof, 4/4: concurrent race (exactly 1 fulfilled, 1 rejected, 1 initiatives row), sequential replay (defined AUDIT_INVALID_STATE, never an unhandled exception), positive control (a single call still succeeds end to end), and a pre-existing-duplicate control on a scratch database seeded with real duplicates before the migration applies.

New real-Postgres proof, 4/4, that AI proposal-only / human-approval enforcement is real: assertAiMayCommit hard-blocks proposal.register and verification.perform (both confirmed present in AI_NEVER_COMMITS), plus a positive control that finding.draft (a capability Teresa legitimately commits) is NOT blocked.
Shared fixtures for the new auditProgramHandoff test directory (used by all six new test files across both AI-HANDOFF and LIFECYCLE).
changedPathRationale.docs/program/evidence/closure/a/AUD-MVP-: Committed evidence markdown: the confirmed gap in registerAsInitiative, the real live schema read before designing the fix, the migration application record (fresh apply then idempotent no-op re-run), the full test breakdown, the AI-proposal-only verification re-read against this HEAD, and one integrator change request (non-blocking UX hardening).

knownConsequences.description: CROSS-LANE NOTE: uq_initiatives_audit_source_once constrains the initiatives table, which Lane B owns. Deliberately scoped to source_type='audit' (the audit handoff path only) and this lane adds no writer to that table, but it is flagged for the integrator since Lane B was not consulted before the index was added.

CORRECTION TO THE PRIOR INVENTORY: audit_domain_events is append-only by service-layer discipline only, not by a database trigger — a direct SQL UPDATE/DELETE is not blocked, proven by a test that mutates a row directly. 'Immutable audit trail' overstates the current guarantee. This bears primarily on AUD-MVP-LIFECYCLE-001 (see that record) but is disclosed here because it was found in the same commit.

rollback.mechanism: revert the commit; both new indexes are additive and idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS); the pre-existing-duplicate pre-clean detaches only the identifying pointer on losing rows (source_id / registered_initiative_id set NULL), never deletes a row, so a revert does not lose data either way
rollback.schemaImpact: two new partial unique indexes: initiatives(organization_id, source_id) WHERE source_type='audit', and audit_initiative_proposals(registered_initiative_id) WHERE registered_initiative_id IS NOT NULL
rollback.flagImpact: none — the fix is unconditional, not behind a runtime flag; it is stronger than an application check because it protects the invariant against any future caller of initiatives, not just registerAsInitiative
rollback.oldReaderCompatibility: unaffected — no column or payload shape changed for any existing reader

verdictRationale: G0/G1/G3 shared gates pass at this SHA. The exactly-one-downstream-receipt guarantee is enforced at the database layer (stronger than an application check) and proven 4/4 on real Postgres including a concurrent race, sequential replay, positive control and a pre-existing-duplicate migration-safety control. AI proposal-only / human-approval enforcement is independently re-verified against this HEAD, 4/4. Kernel regression (165/165, read-only) shows no breakage. The one recorded consequence — a cross-lane note about the initiatives-table index — is explicitly non-blocking (scoped by source_type='audit', no writer added by this lane) and the audit_domain_events immutability correction belongs primarily to the LIFECYCLE record. No browser/visual evidence exists, but this task has no UI surface, so that absence does not bear on its DoD.
